infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SiraLink needs microphone access so you can speak your service request in Amharic, Afaan Oromoo, or English.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SiraLink needs your location to find verified workers close to your home.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow SiraLink to use your location to connect with nearby plumbers, electricians, and local workers.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow SiraLink to record your voice to describe the work you need done.
